description: This PHP class 'HelpConfigService' extends 'ConfigService' and provides methods to retrieve help-related configuration values such as the processor class and base URL in the OrangeHRM Help plugin.

classes.name: HelpConfigService
classes.description: Service class for fetching help configuration settings within the OrangeHRM Help plugin.

methods.name: getHelpProcessorClass
methods.description: Returns the configured help processor class name.

methods.name: getBaseHelpUrl
methods.description: Returns the base URL for help resources.
